title: Tabulation source index
statement: Let $\kappa$ be finite, let $m,w,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $F:\kappa\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})$, and let $z$ be a Boolean list. For instruction index $i$ and source $s$, assign an index as follows when $s$ is valid for input bound $|z|+n$, block width $w$, and instruction index $i$: an input $k$ is assigned $n+2+k$ if $k<|z|$, and $k-|z|$ otherwise; a constant bit $b$ is assigned $n+1$ if true and $n$ if false; and block bit $(i',j)$ is assigned the base index of instruction $i'$ plus $m$, the gadget width, and $j$. If the source is invalid, assign $n$.
caveat: The expression relies on the upstream validity predicate, base indices, and gadget width, whose defining constructions are not provided here.
